caption: The drawing depicts a single metal door handle with a latch mechanism, rendered in shades of black and gray on a light beige background. The handle features a curved grip attached to two round backplates, each with three visible mounting holes. The backplates are vertically aligned and are connected to pointed, elongated geometric extensions at both the top and bottom, giving the assemblage a symmetrical, spear-like appearance. At the upper backplate, there is a small protruding latch lever to the left, and above the circular form, a pointed diamond-shaped section extends upward. The handle itself curves outward and then back inward in an arc, terminating in a rounded tip above the lower backplate, which mirrors the upper plate with a similar diamond and point extension beneath. There are no additional objects or background details, and the overall composition is centered on the page.
title: Door Handle with Thumb Press
